source_refs.note: Equations of Angular Motion: a main subheading of 3.1 Angular measurements, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 54-59.

blocks.text: Angular motion ki equations (3.2, 3.3, 3.4 aur 3.5) bilkul linear motion ki equations jaisi hain; bas θ, ω aur α ki jagah S, v aur a rakh dein. Linear motion ki baqi equations inhi se algebra ke zariye nikli thin, is liye angular motion ki bhi waisi hi equations hain. Neeche angular equations aur un ki linear counterparts (jori) di gayi hain:
Equations 3.9 se 3.11 sirf tab sahi hain jab rotation ka axis fixed ho, taake sab angular vectors ki direction ek ho aur unhen scalars ki tarah istemal kiya ja sake.

blocks.title: Example 3.1
blocks.problem: Bijli ka pankha 3 rev s⁻¹ se ghoom raha hai. Band karne par woh 18.0 s mein ruk jata hai. Deceleration (speed ka kam hona) uniform (ek jaisi) maan kar us ki value nikalein. Rukne se pehle pankhe ne kitne chakkar (revolutions) lagaye?
steps: Diya gaya: ωᵢ = 3.0 rev s⁻¹, ω_f = 0 (ruk gaya), t = 18.0 s; α = ?, θ = ?
Eq. 3.9 (ω_f = ωᵢ + αt) se: α = (ω_f − ωᵢ)/t = (0 − 3.0) rev s⁻¹ / 18.0 s = −0.167 rev s⁻² (minus ka matlab speed kam ho rahi hai)
blocks.answer: α = −0.167 rev s⁻², aur pankha rukne se pehle 27 chakkar lagata hai.

blocks.prompt: 108 km h⁻¹ se chalti car ke pahiye ka diameter 60 cm hai; pahiye ki angular speed rad s⁻¹ aur rev s⁻¹ mein nikalein. Phir: 1800 rev min⁻¹ par chalti motor band ki jati hai aur 20 s mein uniform taur par ruk jati hai; woh kitne chakkar lagati hai?
blocks.explanation: v = 108 km h⁻¹ = 30 m s⁻¹ aur r = 0.30 m, to ω = v/r = 100 rad s⁻¹ = 100/(2π) ≈ 16 rev s⁻¹. Motor: ωᵢ = 1800 rev min⁻¹ = 30 rev s⁻¹, ω_f = 0, t = 20 s, to α = −30/20 = −1.5 rev s⁻², aur θ = 30 × 20 + ½(−1.5)(20)² = 600 − 300 = 300 rev.

items: 1 rad: arc = radius. θ = S/r, S = rθ; 1 rev = 2π rad = 360°, 1 rad = 57.3°.
Angular displacement Δθ (chhoti ho to vector), counter clockwise positive, direction right hand rule se axis ke saath.
ω = Δθ/Δt (rad s⁻¹ ya rpm); α = Δω/Δt (rad s⁻²); v = rω, aₜ = rα; linear velocity tangent ke saath.
Fixed axis ke liye: ω_f = ωᵢ + αt; 2αθ = ω_f² − ωᵢ²; θ = ωᵢt + ½αt². Example 3.1: −0.167 rev s⁻², 27 rev.
